name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native capability-based selective routing with solo default, bounded delegation, primary verification, and fresh audit.

interface.shortDescription: Route by task capability while keeping the current primary model in charge.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor declares a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools. Solo is the default. Delegate is limited to bounded, fully specified, low-risk implementation. Escalation and audit use the current primary model and reasoning effort through the spawn contract rather than family-specific TOML pins. The primary verifies all auxiliary work, audit requests read-only isolation, and missing or conflicting routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Default to solo; delegate only bounded low-risk work and escalate only on newly observed risk.
